scenicChapters.title: Salkammergut Lakes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 25 km this is Salkammergut Lakes Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Salkammergut Lakes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 15 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

salkammergut-lakes-road.story: 92 km one way from Salzburg - plan on about 1 h 31 of riding. It goes by way of Fuschlsee, St Gilgen, Bad Ischl and Hallstatt. The highest point is about 1,400 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
